intent: Where every agent is right now: one lane per agent over a time window, blocks growing into now, handoffs drawn between lanes, and decisions on the block.
useWhen: watch several agents work in parallel over the last minutes
see who handed work to whom
answer a waiting agent from its block
doNotUseWhen: a list of running agents for chrome — RunningNow

agents.note: { id, name, model?, icon? }[] — one lane each, in order.

tasks.note: { id, agentId, title, status: "done" | "running" | "waiting" | "failed", start, end?, handoffTo?, ask?, summary?, icon? }[]. Times are epoch ms; open tasks grow to now.

now.note: Controlled clock; else it ticks every second.

openTaskId.note: Open block: a detail popover, or a decision for a waiting task.

onOpenTaskChange.note: (id | null) => void. Blocks become buttons; Escape closes.

requirements: lanes are a list; each block is a button named with agent, task, status and duration
the open block's popover is a named dialog; Escape closes it
the decision popover focuses Approve; Reject and Approve show Esc and ⏎
axis and handoff lines are aria-hidden
the running shimmer and popover motion use transform and opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local AgentLanes, Gantt, or AgentTimeline
Do not encode status by color only; blocks and lanes carry text
Waiting uses caution tokens until an attention role exists
snippet: <AgentLanes agents={agents} tasks={tasks} now={now} openTaskId={openId} onOpenTaskChange={setOpenId} onApprove={approve} onReject={reject} />
